label: Bible Study
prompt: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and _____ of all.
verse: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
note: The disciples had argued about who was greatest — so Jesus sat down and redefined the word.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy _____ Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
verse: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
note: Timothy's faith had a family tree: grandmother Lois, mother Eunice, and then him.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But when he saw the wind _____, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
verse: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
note: Peter was doing fine on the water until he noticed the wind was boisterous — then the sinking started.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I drew them with _____ of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
verse: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
note: God led Israel like a father teaching a toddler to walk — with human ropes, with bands of love.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath _____ gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
verse: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
note: Miriam, timbrel in hand, led Israel's women in the victory song at the sea: he 'hath triumphed gloriously.'
